Soul Rise by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 In the heart of Seagrove, welcome to Soul Rise, an exquisite coastal retreat with a private pool! Recently built in late 2023, this 4-bedroom haven features luxurious hardwood flooring throughout and amenities like a built-in gas grill on the adorable back porch, a six-seater golf cart, private heated pool, and four bicycles for local exploration. Inside, the gorgeous, open living and dining area is great for quality time, while the chef's kitchen is a dream come true. The spacious home comfortably sleeps 12. On the first floor, a guest room, queen, features a gorgeous full bathroom. Upstairs, the primary bedroom, king, features another lavish bathroom with an oversized shower, and a private balcony that stretches the length of the home. The opposite side of the second floor hosts a spacious guest room with two full beds, a spacious bunk room with twin-over-twin bunks, and a beautiful hall bathroom, with a tub-shower combo. Less than a quarter mile from the beach, Soul Rise is a perfect home base for all things 30A. Explore Seagrove’s many treasures with ease using the golf cart or bicycles provided. Book your stay at Soul Rise today and enjoy the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and 30A fun Welcome!

Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - .4 miles to San Juan Beach Access - 2582 sq. ft. - 4 bedroom, 3 bath - Private pool (can be seasonally heated for $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - 4 adult bikes - Complimentary 6-seater golf cart Overnight: - Queen in guest room, shared hall bathroom with shower only - King in primary bedroom, private bathroom with shower only - 2 full beds in guest room, shared hall bathroom with tub/shower - 2 twin over twin bunks in bunkroom, shared hall bathroom with tub/shower Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
